wnba.Headline: Which WNBA players have the most rebounds in a game?
wnba.Description: Angel Reese broke the WNBA single-game rebounding record during the 2026 season.

wnba.Headline: 2026 FIBA Women's World Cup: Team USA analysis, rankings, rosters
wnba.Description: Sixteen nations will compete in the World Cup in Berlin starting Friday. Team USA and France are front-runners.

wnba.Headline: Liberty's Satou Sabally (concussion) out remainder of season
wnba.Description: The Liberty announced Thursday that forward Satou Sabally will miss the remainder of the season as she continues to recover from a concussion sustained in June.

wnba.Headline: How Bueckers, Clark, Reese will impact Team USA at World Cup
wnba.Description: The future is here for Team USA as Paige Bueckers, Caitlin Clark, Angel Reese and others make their debut in a major event.

wnba.Headline: Russell Westbrook joins board of basketball league Project B
wnba.Description: Recently retired Russell Westbrook has joined new men's and women's basketball league Project B as a co-founder and chief strategy officer.

wnba.Headline: How do the WNBA playoffs work? Dates, format and more
wnba.Description: The 2026 WNBA playoffs begins on Sept. 27. Learn more about postseason dates, rules, and stats now.

wnba.Headline: Wings' Li to miss FIBA World Cup due to lost passport
wnba.Description: China will have to play without Li Yueru at the women's FIBA World Cup after her replacement passport was lost in the mail ahead of the tournament that starts in Germany this week.

wnba.Headline: Why are there no WNBA games for two weeks? More about FIBA break
wnba.Description: League stars will be lacing up their shoes, but it won't be on WNBA courts.

wnba.Headline: 2026 WNBA championship odds: Lynx still odds-on title favorites; Aces, Valkyries next
wnba.Description: The Lynx remain odds-on favorites to win the WNBA championship, while the red-hot Valkyries are back up to third on the oddsboard.

wnba.Headline: U.S. coach Kara Lawson calls World Cup most challenging
wnba.Description: U.S. coach Kara Lawson says this version of the FIBA World Cup is the most challenging she's seen.

wnba.Headline: Sky's Skylar Diggins (knee) to miss remainder of season
wnba.Description: Chicago Sky guard Skylar Diggins will miss the remainder of the WNBA's season as she continues to recover from a right knee injury, the team announced Tuesday.

wnba.Headline: WNBA Power Rankings: Lynx dethroned, Sparks bump up
wnba.Description: What should every team be focused on when play resumes after the FIBA World Cup?

wnba.Headline: Lauren Jackson on A'ja Wilson: 'There'd be battles, for sure'
wnba.Description: Australian basketball icon Lauren Jackson praises four-time WNBA MVP A'Ja Wilson, and believes the pair would've been a great matchup back in Jackson's prime.

wnba.Headline: How A'ja Wilson and Kelsey Plum injuries impact USA at World Cup
wnba.Description: How will the deepest roster in the world make up for A'ja Wilson's absence? And what might be next for Kelsey Plum?

wnba.Headline: A'ja Wilson, Kelsey Plum to miss the FIBA Women's World Cup
wnba.Description: Kelsey Plum and A'ja Wilson will miss the FIBA Women's World Cup for health reasons, with the Mercury announcing that Plum will miss the rest of the 2026 season. Kiki Iriafen and Sonia Citron will replace Plum and Wilson, USA Basketball announced Monday.

wnba.Headline: Shepard has 22nd double-double this season, Wings beat Sun 97-71
wnba.Description: — Arike Ogunbowale scored 18 points, Jessica Shepard had 17 points and 10 rebounds, and the Dallas Wings beat the Connecticut Sun 97-71 on Sunday night in the final game before the FIBA World Cup break.
